messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm putting together the new runtime dashboards for KV cache hit/miss, batching latency, and model-attach tail latency. Need input on alerting thresholds and pager routing before I ship.

maria: Thanks. Are we treating KV cache p95 and request error rate as page vs. ticket? We usually page on SLO burn or sustained tail latency, not 1-off p95 spikes.

jon: Agree. Suggest page when we see sustained SLO burn > 4% over 30m or p95 latency > 120ms for 10m. Otherwise create a ticket/ops alert.

tess: For batching latency, p90 > 80ms is noisy during traffic spikes. Maybe only page if p99 > 250ms or if request success rate drops > 0.5% over 5m.

nguyen: From infra side — we need these metrics to have consistent labels: cluster, region, pool (dedicated|shared), model_family. That lets us route to the right oncall and filter dashboards.

alex: Good call on labels. I'll annotate panels to require those labels. Also thinking an SLO-burn alert that uses a burn rate calculation over 1h/6h windows and maps to pagerduty service based on cluster.

maria: Can you paste a draft prometheus rule we can iterate on? A short example helps the oncall team review routing.

alex: Sure — draft below:
```yaml
- alert: Runtime_SLO_Burn_High
  expr: |
    (sum(rate(error_budget_consumed_total[1h])) by (cluster, region, pool)) > 0.04
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
    pager_team: runtime-oncall
  annotations:
    summary: "Runtime SLO burn high ({{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.pool }})"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-slo-burn"
```

jon: That looks reasonable. Two asks: 1) use a derived metric name we agreed on `error_budget_consumed_total` (ok). 2) include `team:` label for PD routing override if pool == dedicated.

tess: Add a companion latency rule for p95:
```yaml
- alert: Runtime_P95_Latency_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster, model_family)) > 0.12
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
    pager_team: runtime-oncall
```

nguyen: Make sure runtime exposes `runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket` with `model_family` and `pool`. I filed a tiny runtime PR to add `pool` label for the batching path — link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/214

maria: On the PD mapping — we need a matrix: shared -> platform-oncall first, dedicated -> runtime-oncall first, then escalation to infra. Can we encode that via `pager_team` label and PD routing rules?

jon: Yes — PD has `routing keys` per team. We can map label `pager_team=runtime-oncall` -> service `runtime-inference-prod`. For shared we set `pager_team=platform-oncall`. I'll draft the PD mapping in the alerting repo.

alex: I'll open the alerting repo PR with the rules. Also adding dashboard links and a small table mapping label combos -> PD service in the PR description.

oncall-bot: Reminder: If you set `severity: page` please ensure runbook has a last-reviewed timestamp and postmortem template linked.

tess: Runbook exists but is old — I'll update runbook quick and add a short triage checklist: "is model pinned? Is cache warming? Any recent deploys?".

devops-bot: dashboard created: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/runtime-kv-batching-latency?orgId=1

maria: One more thing — thresholds should be adjustable per region. In EU we have slightly higher p95 latencies due to colo differences. Suggest region-specific overrides in the rules (labels) rather than duplicating rules.

jon: Good. Implementation plan: alex opens PR with 3 alerts (SLO burn, p95 latency, error rate), include `cluster/region/pool/model_family` labels, doc the PD mapping table. me + tess review. nguyen validates labels on the metrics side. maria signs off on thresholds.

alex: Plan noted. Target PR today EOD, request reviews from @jon @tess @nguyen @maria. Will also add a short playbook section for noisy incidents and fallback to ticketing.

maria: Thanks — once PR lands, we'll schedule a 20min sync with oncall leads to confirm PD routing and escalation times.

jon: I'll pre-create PD services for `runtime-inference-prod` and `platform-shared-prod` so we don't block the PR.

nguyen: After PR merges, I'll bump runtime canary to include the `pool` label in metrics and watch for label cardinality issues.

alex: Awesome. If anyone spots a missing metric or label, post here or tag me. I'll add the final alert json to the repo and link back.

maria: LGTM. Closing loop once PR merged and sync done.
